bundle.shortDescription: A desktop pet that reminds you to take breaks.
bundle.longDescription: Pawse puts a little cat or dog along the bottom of your screen. It walks around, naps, grooms, does tricks when you double-click it, and goes to bed at night. Every so often it comes over and asks you to take a stretch break, and stretches with you. Clicks go straight through to your apps everywhere except the pet itself. Free and open source, on Windows, macOS and Linux, with nothing sent anywhere.
